steps.content:
October 4, N.F. 112, 8:23 PM
Eastside - Midsummer Night's Club

It happened in an instant. Before the impact, you and the 9th Agency agent were still observing the situation at the surveillance point outside the Midsummer Night's Club. The investigation team was on standby nearby. The operation had not yet started, and the streets were teeming with people.
Suddenly, colorful rays of light resembling oil film stream out of the club, flooding the entire block. The light fades, and darkness descends like night.

Now, only you and the two Sinners remain awake in the entire affected area. You walk through the corridors of the empty club, looking for possible clues while fighting off condensed contaminants from time to time.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Using the map provided by the 9th Agency, the Nightmare has already investigated the club, but could not find anyone "sober." Everyone had fallen into a deep sleep.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pwahaha... I can't do this. Don't talk while wearing that. I just can't hold it back, hahahaha... And I can't breathe when I laugh hahahaha.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is a necessary protective measure. This area is blanketed by gasified Ambrosia. It's another type of spiritual contamination, and is very dangerous.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, control yourself. The Hypercubes in your protective mask are starting to deplete faster.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hahahaha... ${PlayerName}, you should stop talking, too... Ouch!
It always takes a thwack from Hecate for Hella to stop.

Doyle's disappearance rang the alarm bells for everyone. The FAC launched an emergency operation proposal overnight, and finally overcame obstruction from the City Council to dispatch counter-Mania troops into Eastside's District 14. You also make preparations in advance to fight against the Sinner.

Yet no one expected that the decisive battle would suddenly start like this. You've done all you could, yet still lost the upper hand to the new, unknown strain of Mania. All the frontline surveillance troops are trapped in the contaminated area, yourself included.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: That Sinner deliberately made it seem like Ambrosia was extremely rare, to hide the fact that she had enough to create a large-scale contamination to control the area swiftly. Judging from the M-value fluctuations, she's already an S-Class Sinner.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: All right, Chief. Go after her. Keep this protective mask on. If the Hypercubes inside get used up, remember to replenish them immediately. We've prepared for you an ample supply.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: We will contain the contaminants from the Sleepwalkers outside, and try to hold out until you get in. There are quite a few of them. Once our protective gear gets exhausted, we'll just get some good sleep.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: We're leaving the rest up to you. Don't let "Miss Serpent" give us more surprises.

You return to the banquet hall of the club again. The hall is unusually quiet. Unconscious people are sprawled out everywhere, curled up like babies dreaming sweet dreams. They puff out traces of contamination as they murmur happily in their sleep.
The faint and dreamy colors flow gently in the air. If you take off your mask, you'd definitely smell the familiar sweet and nauseous aroma of Ambrosia.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is that circus Sinner really here? Even Nightmare can't find her. Where should we go look?
The faintly sparkling light all float toward the same direction. You stretch out your hand. Your shackles cannot be fully activated, but they can sense the faint flow.
You lead the team up the stairs into an elegant office.
Sinner Serpent isn't here. Behind the spacious desk is Eirene, President of Quinn. She is leaning back against her chair, brows relaxed and sleeping soundly.
Half a glass of Ambrosia sits on the desk. Beneath the glass is a note with a small snake symbol.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She used Ambrosia to hide in someone else's dream, just like she did with Mess.
You pick up the glass of Ambrosia. Faintly colored mist rises from the mouth of the glass. This is definitely the epicenter of the mist in the club, and Eirene's image flickers inside.
You take off your mask, hold your breath and gulp down all the Ambrosia. You're overwhelmed by the familiar dizziness. You close your eyes, and when you open them again...
You're in the center of a huge chessboard. The sound of chess pieces hitting the board echoes from one end of the chessboard.
The next second, you see a huge shadow looming toward you!
